items.title: 67246_Buck Clayton oral history interview
items.q: But with Echols it was the first band that I played with that played arrangements.

ctx.x: Not with sort of dead or...

Yes, that was just a jam session. You know like, we all play. But with Echols it was the first band that I played with that played arrangements. Except for Mouse and his Music, we used to play stock arrangements with Mouse and his Music, 'Sonny Boy' and things like that.
Mouse and his Music that was only what, six pieces?
